blocks.text: Microsoft Surface Pro 7+ Tablet — featuring the iconic 2‑in‑1 design with the signature built-in Kickstand, easily transforms into a full laptop with a keyboard. Use it as an ultra-portable tablet, a perfectly angled digital canvas, or a docked workstation. Please note that this is a renewed product.Powerful Performance & Reliable SpeedEquipped with an 11th Gen Intel Core i5-1135G7, 8 GB LPDDR4x RAM, and a 128 GB SSD for smooth multitasking, fast boot times, and efficient performance across everyday productivity tasks.Vibrant Display12.3-inch PixelSense multi-touch display with 2736 × 1824 resolution, providing sharp visuals and a responsive touchscreen experience for work, creative tasks, and media consumption.Integrated GraphicsIntel Iris Xe Graphics deliver enhanced visual performance for light photo editing, streaming, and casual gaming.Versatile Connectivity1 x USB-C port, 1x USB-A port, and a headphone jack for flexible device and accessory connections.Cameras & Audio5.0 MP front-facing and 8.0 MP rear-facing cameras, dual far-field studio microphones, and 1.6 W stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos for clear video calls, recording, and immersive sound.Wireless & NetworkWi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 ensure fast, reliable wireless connectivity for internet, peripherals, and accessories.Portable & Flexible DesignIconic 2-in-1 form factor with signature built-in Kickstand, allowing use as an ultra-portable tablet, perfectly angled digital canvas, or a docked workstation with keyboard (sold separately).Operating System & PowerPre-installed Windows 11 Pro, included power supply and battery for all-day productivity.

items.label: Powerful Performance & Speed
items.value: The Microsoft Surface Pro 7+ Tablet (Renewed) is equipped with an 11th Gen Intel Core i5-1135G7 processor, 8 GB RAM, and a 128 GB SSD for smooth multitasking, fast boot times, and efficient performance across everyday productivity tasks.

items.label: Vibrant Touchscreen Display
items.value: 12.3-inch PixelSense multi-touch display with 2736 × 1824 resolution delivers sharp visuals, accurate colors, and a responsive touchscreen for work, creative tasks, and media consumption.

items.label: Enhanced Graphics & Audio
items.value: Intel Iris Xe Graphics handle light photo editing, streaming, and casual gaming, while dual far-field studio microphones and 1.6 W stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos provide clear calls and immersive sound.

items.label: Versatile Connectivity & Portable Design
items.value: Features 1 × USB-C, 1 × USB-A, headphone jack, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth 5.0. Iconic 2-in-1 form factor with built-in Kickstand allows use as a tablet, digital canvas, or docked workstation with keyboard (sold separately).

items.label: Windows 11 Pro & All-Day Productivity
items.value: Pre-installed Windows 11 Pro with included power supply and battery ensures seamless operation, productivity, and mobility. Platinum color for a sleek, professional look.
